claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_multi_mechanics_bundle
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item surface allows exactly one mechanics family, but this item has an always-on passive benefit plus separate activated abilities. A single record needs to compose passive and activation behavior honestly.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain a +1 bonus to saving throws while you wear it. ... you can take a Magic action to remove one of the stars and expend it to cast the level 5 version of Magic Missile. ... you can take a Magic action to enter the Astral Plane

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence.dusk
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's expendable stars recharge on a fixed daily dusk cadence, and the current surface only models dawn, rests, or never.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Daily at dusk, 1d6 removed stars reappear on the robe.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: transport_exile
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Astral Plane feature is not ordinary teleportation. It moves the wearer and carried gear to another plane, persists there until a later activation, and returns them to the previous plane at the prior space or nearest unoccupied space.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can take a Magic action to enter the Astral Plane along with everything you are wearing and carrying. You remain there until you take a Magic action to return to the plane you were on. You reappear in the last space you occupied or, if that space is occupied, the nearest unoccupied space.
